edgar_concentrations.excerpt: There are no significant concentrations by state or geographical location. 9 Table of Contents Variable Interest Entities Consolidated Variable Interest Entities Our primary source of funding consumer receivables is through a secured line of credit. We transfer a portion of our notes receivable to a wholly owned, bankruptcy-remote special purpose entity (the “SPE”), which then pledges such receivables as collateral for our line of credit. We continue to service all receivables sold and pledged to the SPE. The amount we can borrow under our line of credit is dependent on the amount of eligible, pledged notes receivable we have sold to the SPE. While we serve as a limited guarantor for the SPE and are subject to certain financial covenants, our line of credit provider does not have full recourse against our general credit and may absorb losses in the event of default if the cash receipts related to our pledged notes receivable are not sufficient to repay the outstanding line of credit balance. Refer to Note 7. Line of Credit for more information about our line of credit and the relationship between our line of credit and our notes receivable. We are required to evaluate the SPE for consolidation, which we have concluded is a VIE. We have the ability to direct the activities that most significantly impact the economic performance of our wholly owned SPE. We also have the obligation to absorb losses and the right to proceeds related to the pledged notes receivable in the SPE, exposing us to losses and returns that could potentially be significant. As such, we have determined that we are the primary beneficiary of the SPE and are required to consolidate the entity as a VIE. Unconsolidated Variable Interest Entities Under an arrangement with a third-party partner, our originating partner sells eligible long-term installment loans originated through the Sezzle Platform to three statutory trusts (the "Financing Entities") formed to purchase and hold these loans. Each Financing Entity is a variable interest entity and are substantially similar; therefore, we disclose information about them in the aggregate. Our variable interests consist of the servicing and ancillary fees we earn for servicing the loans and our obligations to repurchase loans upon breaches of certain representations and warranties made by us or our originating partner. As of September 30, 2026, the unpaid principal balance of loans held by the Financing Entities was approximately $ 24.4 million.

findings.claim: Q1 2026 活躍訂閱用戶 714,000，年增 48.4%；訂閱＋隨選月付用戶合計 887,000，年增 34.8%；季均購買頻率 7.1 次（前年 6.1 次）。搜尋摘要稱此為由單次 BNPL 交易轉向訂閱式經常性收費關係，並以 Sezzle Anywhere 虛擬卡擴大可用商家範圍。

findings.source: TradingView/Zacks：SEZL's Merchant Acquisition Strategy Vital for Its Growth Trajectory；Investing.com：Sezzle Q2 2026 slides

prior_meta.trap_label: 信用週期未經壓力測試＋治理雜音
prior_meta.oneliner: 交易量與訂閱戶仍在高速成長，股價三個月跌 37% 後 FY2 本益比約 17 倍；真正的考題是下半年新客湧入後的信用損失，等第三季提列守住全年 3% 再進場

start.basis: FY2026E 共識 EPS（Koyfin 2026-09-26）；終端倍數套在終端年當年度 EPS，口徑同為 FY1

prior_meta.rearm_trigger: 第三季財報提列／GMV 守在全年 2.5–3% 指引內且淨交易利潤率 ≥55% 即進場首倉；股價先跌破 95 美元而信用未惡化則分批反買

catalysts.watch: 全年提列實績、2027 EPS 指引對共識 6.65

kill_metrics.metric: 淨交易利潤率（營收減交易相關成本占營收）
kill_metrics.bear_threshold: 低於 55% 連兩季 → 清倉
kill_metrics.source: 季度財報新聞稿與法說簡報

kill_metrics.metric: TTM 提列／GMV 與全年提列指引
kill_metrics.bear_threshold: 高於 3.5% 連兩季，或指引上緣調到 3% 以上 → 減碼至半倉
終止或不續約且 90 天內無替代 → 清倉

kill_metrics.metric: 證券集體訴訟與 SEC 動作
kill_metrics.bear_threshold: 起訴並通過駁回動議 → 減碼；SEC 正式調查或重編 → 清倉

rows.觸發器（白話一句）: 第三季財報檢查信用：提列季節性上升的幅度
rows.指標與門檻: 全年提列仍守 2.5–3% 指引且淨交易利潤率 ≥55%
rows.命中後動作: 兩項過關 → 進場首倉（半倉）；未過 → 不追，續看第四季

rows.觸發器（白話一句）: 管理層把全年提列區間上調到 3% 以上
rows.命中後動作: 持有則減碼至半倉；未持有則不進場，等兩季新客損失數據

rows.觸發器（白話一句）: 首倉後訂閱與信用雙雙過關再補足
rows.指標與門檻: 訂閱戶年增 ≥30% 且 2026 全年提列 ≤3.0%

rows.觸發器（白話一句）: 成長減速超出基期解釋
rows.指標與門檻: 營收年增連兩季低於 20%，或第三季交易量年增低於 25%

rows.觸發器（白話一句）: 證券訴訟從調查變成正式起訴
rows.指標與門檻: 集體訴訟正式起訴並通過駁回動議；SEC 正式調查或財報重編
rows.命中後動作: 起訴 → 停止加碼；通過駁回動議 → 減碼至半倉；SEC 介入或重編 → 清倉

rows.觸發器（白話一句）: 發卡夥伴或州法規收緊
rows.指標與門檻: 發卡夥伴終止且 90 天內無替代；州法把訂閱費或預支費納入利率上限；消費者集體訴訟正式起訴
rows.命中後動作: 規則收緊或消費者訴訟 → 減碼；發卡夥伴終止且無替代 → 清倉

rows.觸發器（白話一句）: 大商家與平台集中風險
rows.指標與門檻: Target 導入第二家或終止合作；任一大平台終止合作；全年收益率低於 10.5%
rows.命中後動作: 停止加碼並重估情境樹
未送件 → 第二曲線降為更遠期選擇權，不動倉位

rows.觸發器（白話一句）: 股價先跌、信用未惡化時分批反買
rows.指標與門檻: 股價低於 95 美元（FY2 約 14 倍，接近 52 週均線 95.35 美元）且提列仍在指引內

qa_flags.question: Tomasello：下半年營收成長為何較Q2減速？Kumar同樣追問2H減速驅動因素
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO以H1對H2的「基本算術」與財測保守（部分產品未計入）回應，未拆解減速成因；Kumar一題則轉談收益率低基期

qa_flags.question: Goetsch：行銷支出是否持續或加碼？
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO答「I think it depends」，以開油門比喻、「all things being equal」及新產品可能抵銷作答，未給支出水準

qa_flags.question: Tomasello：回收期這麼好為何收斂行銷、是否有回收期承壓訊號
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO以「comfort／edge」風險偏好回答，未直接說明有無回收期壓力的數據

qa_flags.question: Tomasello：營收成長約2/3來自用戶、1/3來自ARPU，後續是否維持此組合
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO稱不看此拆分，改談產品成功率與SezzleCash/Send，未回答組合走向
